title: Resolute Sentinel joint exercise in Peru as a possible cover
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Resolute Sentinel joint exercise in Peru as a possible cover, about c. 2023 at Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was called Resolute Sentinel, and it involved it involved uh basically every military agency

plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, talks about Resolute Sentinel, a military exercise held in Peru around 2023. He says it involved basically every US military agency, and he suggests it may have served as a cover for something else going on there. If so, it would mean a public exercise was hiding a secret operation.
